title: Snoutbot reviews
commentFailed: The comment could not be posted.
rerunFailed: That review could not be run again. Check the connection to the host in Settings.

poll.noRepos: No repository is being watched. Add one in Settings.

hints.deterministic: No model. The rules' own words.
hints.byok: Your own key or Ollama server.

check.tooltip: Ask GitHub for new pull requests and mentions now
check.tooltipOff: Turn Snoutbot on in Settings first

detail.shaTitle: The commit this review is OF. A review is always of a sha, never of a pull request.
detail.localErrors: What the database said ({count}), shown only here
detail.notPostedAs: Nothing has been posted yet. It goes on the {pullRequest} as **{login}**.
detail.notPostedYou: Nothing has been posted yet. It goes on the {pullRequest} as you.
detail.wroteThisTitle: This is what wrote the review you are reading

empty.title: No reviews yet
empty.connect: Connect a GitHub or GitLab account and Snoutbot can start watching your repositories.
empty.addRepo: Add a repository to watch, and bind it to one of your connections.
empty.off: Watching is switched off. Turn it on and Snoutbot will check for pull requests that touch SQL.
empty.nothing: Nothing has been reviewed yet. Reviews appear here as they run, and stay for this session.
empty.note: Reviews are held in memory while the app runs, not saved to disk. A review is about one commit, and a stale one is worse than none.

depth.schema: Read the schema of {on}, ran no queries
depth.schemaBound: Read the schema, ran no queries
depth.static: Read the diff only, the database was not consulted

notice.awaiting: Snoutbot has a review of {what} for you to read
notice.awaitingDetail: {summary}. Nothing is posted to GitHub until you say so.

toast.awaiting: {summary}, waiting for you to post it
